message: Madam, meeting you is truly a pleasure.
Should you need a lower price, I can revise my bid.
Would $480 work?
Thank you!
Available now, I’m ready and able to begin.
For editing/proofreading, I can do 480.00, madam—would that work for you?
Nonfiction texts are a real passion of mine; thank you for considering me.
My budget is unfortunately capped at $350, Nora, so I can’t proceed at $480. Thank you for reaching out, and I hope we can work together another time!
For this engagement only, I can bring the price down to 350.00.
As a new-client special available today, I can take 130.00 off.
Thanks again!
With the revised terms accepted, will you be able to finish by Friday? Thank you.
By COB on Thursday, I will have the work finished, madam.
For each manuscript, would you like three tracked copies and three clean copies? Also, I edit in American rather than UK English.
Please attach the files and expedite the offer; once both are in place, I can begin immediately—coffee in hand!
Thank you!
The opportunity to serve you has me very excited.
Because the books target the American KDP market, your proposal is perfect—yes, please proceed with the tracked and clean copies!
Excellent! 🥰
I’ve included the manuscripts here. If you have any questions, please let me know. Talk soon!
I’m sorry, but Word or shared Google docs are the only formats I can edit in.
Can you convert manuscripts into a supported format?
Thanks again!
Technical work isn’t my strength, although I am a skilled editor.
The formatting became flawed when I tried converting the manuscripts to Word on my own.
Kindly advise.
When sharing Google docs, use nora@cedarpost.example as my email address.
My sincere apologies again. Please tell me whether conversion can be done; if not, I can cancel the contract.
Hello, Nora! Shortly, I’ll start investigating it.
Thank you 🙏🏻
Could you check whether this format is acceptable, Nora? If it looks slightly off, don’t worry; the books will be professionally formatted later.
Confirmed---ty!
If you need help with formatting or cover design, I recommend this specialist: <https://www.harborfolio.example/freelancers/eline-marcek>. She’s skilled, fast, and affordable.
Thank you for completing this so quickly, Nora! Have a great day!
Along with beta and alpha reading, I also edit and proofread fiction and children's books. Thank you again—let’s reconnect soon!
